THE PROBLEM · SOLO SELLER BOTTLENECK

One return. Four disconnected sources.

Four systems. No traceable decision. Without a shared record, the seller connects order facts, video, and policy manually from memory.

01 BUYER MESSAGE
Subjective text & unindexed video claim in chat
02 ORDER RECORD
Shopify manifest: HEAD-WHT-02, Matte White, ₹1,499
03 COURIER STATUS
Shippo scan: delivered 4 days ago (Day 4 of 7)
04 RETURN POLICY
7-day defect window; security packaging tag rule
→
THE MISSING LINK
NO SHARED EVIDENCE RECORD
“What evidence supports this return decision?”
Four disconnected sources. One seller making the call.
The gap is the absence of an auditable artifact linking order truth, video keyframes, and policy before money moves.
Fraud research: 9% strict fraud (NRF 2025) vs 15.14% fraud + abuse (Appriss/Deloitte 2024). Details in notes. Slide 2 / 6

SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE · DYNAMIC AGENTIC GOVERNANCE

Models observe. Code verifies. Seller authorizes.

Dynamic action selection and stateful resumption under deterministic human authorization.

MODEL
Plan and observe
Planner proposes typed actions · Vision model generates cited observations.
CODE
Retrieve, validate and enforce rules
Backend code validates schemas · FFmpeg extracts frames · Python code evaluates rules P-01 to P-08.
SELLER
Approve consequential actions
Fail-closed authorization gate · 1-click human merchant confirmation before refund release.
DYNAMIC STATEFUL CLARIFICATION LOOP (CASE C)
DARK EVIDENCE
→
ASK FOR PHOTO
→
WAITING_FOR_EVIDENCE
→
CUSTOMER UPLOAD
→
RESUME CASE
→
SELLER REVIEW
Agent calls ask_for_evidence() on low-light frames, serializes context, and resumes execution upon customer upload.
SECONDARY PS-04 ROUTE ("Where is my order?"): Store API → Courier API → Customer Reply (Zero vision overhead)
Structured JSON Audit Log recorded at every state transition.
Structured JSON Audit Log recorded at every state transition · Decision priority: Contradiction > Hard fail > Unclear only > All pass Slide 4 / 6
DEMO SCENARIOS · BEHAVIORAL MATRIX

Different evidence. Different action.

Predictable, controlled prototype responses across four distinct evidence conditions.

01 · CONSISTENT
Evidence Supported · Manifest matches, packaging tag present, cosmetic defect observed
→
PREPARE SELLER REVIEW
Drafts mock return label and refund draft in pending_return_receipt. Money releases only on physical receipt.
02 · CONTRADICTION
Ordered White, Observed Black · HEAD-WHT-02 ordered vs Frame 00:07 Black item
→
ESCALATE TO SELLER
Policy P-03 blocks automation. Inhibits label and refund. Seller selects: mis-shipment / box label / warehouse inspection.
03 · UNCLEAR
Insufficient Visual Evidence · 4s low-light video (brightness 28/255), barcode obscured
→
ASK AND RESUME
Calls ask_for_evidence(); transitions to WAITING_FOR_EVIDENCE; resumes context on upload (1 retry limit).
04 · SEQUENCE
Continuity Uncertain · Staged take from sealed parcel opening to product reveal
→
INSPECT SEQUENCE CONTINUITY
Expected prototype behavior: inspect sequence continuity and flag cutaways for seller review.
Staged prototype scenarios · Expected agent behaviors, not measured production metrics Slide 5 / 6
